subject: Stakeholder mapping + next steps — procurement & champion enablement (Finovate Bank)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Higgins <tom.higgins@finovatebank.com>, Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — stakeholder mapping + procurement questions

Hi Tom & Priya —

Great to meet today — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of call:
- Use case: customer support automation + internal knowledge retrieval for payments ops.
- Primary goals: reduce average handle time by 30% and deflect Tier 1 tickets.
- Performance needs: sub-200ms per-token latency for critical flows (EU/US traffic), and SOC 2 + data residency assurances.

Stakeholder map (from today):
- Champion: Tom Higgins (payments product lead) — owns day-to-day requirements and internal enablement.
- Economic buyer: Priya Sinha (Head of Digital Products) — will sign T&Cs and budget.
- Security/legal/procurement: Procurement + Security (you mentioned a centralized procurement queue and a security review).

Ask / next steps we agreed on:
1) You to share a list of internal stakeholders we should include in the procurement/security review (names + roles + expected reviewers).
2) We (to Redwood) to send a short packet: SOC 2 artifact list, data flow diagram, and a tailored ROI one-pager for the payments use case.
3) Schedule a 60-minute procurement workshop (technical + commercial) w/ your security and procurement teams. Suggested dates: next Tue or Wed.

Attached: draft RFI answers (initial pass) and a blank procurement worksheet — use these to route to procurement/security. We also included a one-pager outline for internal champions that Tom can reuse.

If that aligns, I will follow up with exact docs and propose workshop times. Thanks again — excited to help you build this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Finovate_RFI_Security_Answers.pdf (draft), procurement-worksheet.xlsx (blank), Champion_Talk_Tracks.docx (outline)

From: Tom Higgins <tom.higgins@finovatebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@finovatebank.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finovatebank.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — stakeholder mapping + procurement questions

Thanks Marissa — that recap is perfect. A few notes from procurement/security perspective: 

Procurement/security requirements:
- Our procurement cycle typically takes 6-8 weeks for new vendors (RFP/RFI + security review).
- Security will need: SOC 2 Type II report, data flow diagram, encryption at rest/in transit details, and any subcontractor list.
- We have a standardized security questionnaire (I attached the intake form).

Stakeholders to include (initial list):
- Priya Sinha — Economic buyer (Head of Digital Products)
- Mark Chen — Director of Security (mark.chen@finovatebank.com)
- Ayesha Khan — Procurement lead (ayesha.khan@finovatebank.com)
- Lina Alvarez — Legal (lina.alvarez@finovatebank.com)

Timeline constraints: we are launching a pilot in Q4 and would like vendor selection completed by early November to allow integration work. Faster if security clears earlier.

Next steps we are asking of Redwood:
1) Send the SOC 2 summary + our intake answers by end of week.
2) Provide a short ROI one-pager tailored to payments ops we can drop into the internal business case.
3) Join a 60-minute procurement + security workshop on Tue 21 Jul at 10am ET (if that works for your team).

Appreciate you moving quickly on this.

Cheers,
Tom
Product Lead, Payments
Finovate Bank

Attachments: Finovate_Security_Intake_Form.pdf (filled)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Higgins <tom.higgins@finovatebank.com>, Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — stakeholder mapping + procurement questions

Tom — thanks for the detail and the intake form. We are on it. Quick update & attached artifacts: 

What we attached:
- Finovate_RFI_Security_Answers.pdf (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, encryption and subcontractor notes)
- Redwood_ROI_OnePager-Finovate.pdf (tailored ROI for payments ops with conservative and stretch scenarios)
- Champion_Talk_Tracks.docx (short talk tracks and objection handling for Tom as champion)

Proposed workshop: Tue 21 Jul at 10am ET works for our engineering, security, and procurement liaisons. We have scheduled a 60-minute slot and sent a calendar invite to your team. Agenda: 1) Security walkthrough (10-20m), 2) Commercial/contract overview (15m), 3) Integration plan & timelines (20m), 4) Q&A & next steps (5m).

One ask for you before the workshop: please confirm the final list of participants (Mark, Ayesha, Lina or alternates) so we can prepare the right artifacts. Also flag any additional regulatory controls we should highlight (e.g., specific PCI considerations or EU data residency).

If it helps, I have included language in the ROI one-pager that your internal finance team can paste into a business case. Happy to jump on a quick prep call with Tom to run through the champion playbook — Dylan can run that with you early next week.

Thanks — looking forward to the workshop.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_ROI_OnePager-Finovate.pdf, Champion_Talk_Tracks.docx

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Higgins <tom.higgins@finovatebank.com>, Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — stakeholder mapping + procurement questions

Hey Tom / Priya — quick note from engineering/product side: thanks for scheduling the 21 Jul workshop — I am the Redwood technical lead on this engagement. I'll kick off the invite with the meeting notes and a short pre-read (integration checklist + sample deployment options).

Pre-read link: https://drive.google.com/finovate-procurement-worksheet

If you have any specific logs or example payload sizes we should optimize for ahead of the call, please drop them in the pre-read folder. Otherwise we'll plan to demo a live integration pattern and discuss quantization/latency tradeoffs.

See you Tuesday — Dylan
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Dylan.Brooks@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: integration-checklist.pdf
summary: Post-call sales thread covering stakeholder mapping, procurement/security intake, and champion enablement. Attachments include SOC 2 summary and ROI one-pager. Workshop scheduled for 2026-07-21 to review security and procurement with Finovate Bank.
